channel.title: Nature Physics
channel.description: Nature Physics offers news and reviews alongside top-quality research papers in a monthly publication, covering the entire spectrum of physics. Physics addresses the properties and interactions of matter and energy, and plays a key role in the development of a broad range of technologies. To reflect this, Nature Physics covers all areas of pure and applied physics research. The journal focuses on core physics disciplines, but is also open to a broad range of topics whose central theme falls within the bounds of physics.

item.title: [9] Altermagnetic spintronics
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: H. Ohno, L. Šmejkal

Authors: T. Jungwirth, J. Sinova, P. Wadley, et al.

Score 9/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Review on altermagnetism, an explicitly important topic for user, with spintronics relevance.; demoted from A: broad CM, not direct user/project hit

Tags: #altermagnetism #spintronics #superconductivity #review

Abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 06 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03337-w Altermagnetism, a recently identified unconventional magnetic order, might enable fast and efficient spin-based devices. This Review explores its interplay with ferroelectric and superconducting systems and its promise for scalable spintronics.

item.title: [6] Magnon fluctuations find a structure
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Hossein Taghinejad, Mohammad Taghinejad

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Condensed matter paper on magnon fluctuations in magnetic insulators in non-equilibrium states.

Tags: #magnons #magneticmaterials #non-equilibriumphysics

Abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 30 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03354-9 Thermal magnon fluctuations can be selectively redistributed through a process known as squeezing, a phenomenon now observed in magnetic insulators driven into a non-equilibrium state.
